description: Explicit transactions on Workspaces(0), one UPDATE of T each: BeginTrans, update, CommitTrans, close; BeginTrans, update, Rollback, close; two nested BeginTrans levels, update, inner CommitTrans, outer Rollback, close. Asks what the closed file holds after each. Logical outcome scope belongs to R-TXN-1; this asks only the file images. Images: 'before' (the fixture copy as given), then one kept image of the closed file after each step; every step opens the database read/write, makes one mutation and closes it.
retentionNote: Designed r-fmt-2-pres-1 probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
